strategies.instrument: NG futures; contract/security ID must be pinned before activation
strategies.session: Pinned contract's explicit feed session; no automatic roll
strategies.grid_alignment: UTC epoch multiples of 3; latest completed group at or before cutoff, ties ordered by close cursor
strategies.parameter_provenance: Risk and execution settings are provisional paper engineering choices; no measured strategy performance is claimed.
strategies.entry: After the 100 ms simulated delay, recheck the trigger on the latest available completed group. Submit one-contract marketable-limit IOC at the opposing touch plus one tick tolerance in trade direction. A quote is not a fill: require the chosen simulator's executable liquidity and order receipt.
strategies.partial_fills: Retain actual filled quantity and fees; cancel unfilled remainder; do not chase.
strategies.holding: No adds. Manage filled quantity only. Exit on a side reversal, stop, time limit or target according to stated priority.
exit_priority: Integrity failure: cancel pending orders, pause new entries, preserve unresolved exposure if no valid exit quote
strategies.exit_execution: Apply the same latency and executable-quote requirements. No invented fill during a gap. Record slippage beyond stop or target.
strategies.reversal: Exit first; wait cooldown; require a fresh trigger. No automatic reversal.
strategies.duplicates: Each source group/trigger ID is processed once. Each candidate has a separate virtual ledger, with at most one position; no pooled voting.
strategies.no_trade: No entry for group age over 1 second, unresolved sequence gap/reset, clock regression, invalid or crossed quote, unknown contract, missing fee parameter or required zero denominator.
strategies.conflicts: Opposing measured signals remain logged; only the candidate's explicit conflict rules suppress its order. An unresolved source/clock conflict pauses new entries.
strategies.restart: Cancel pending orders and pause. Reconcile journal, position and order IDs; verify a fresh snapshot and the full lookback before resuming.
logging: All opportunities, raw operands, source IDs and separate clocks

strategies.name: Touch order-count imbalance
strategies.thesis: Repeated modest short-horizon midpoint association; incremental dipole value remains unresolved.
strategies.setup: One-tick spread, positive total order count, no open position.

signal.threshold_provenance: Provisional 2:1 count ratio, not a tested or optimized cutoff.

strategies.trigger: Cross into a qualifying side from a previously nonqualifying or opposite eligible grid state. First observation initializes state without entry.
strategies.adverse: Many flat and adverse outcomes; effect decays; no verified net return.
strategies.dipole_role: Log actual recognition and fresh/expiring flow for comparison; they are not extra confirming votes.
strategies.initialization: Any missing/stale/gap/reset state clears previous trigger state. First valid grid observation after recovery initializes without entry.
strategies.stop_and_target_measurement: From actual weighted entry fill: long exits evaluated at executable bid; short at executable ask. Stop is adverse4ticks, target favorable4ticks. Trigger does not guarantee that fill price.
strategies.hold_clock: Maximum hold starts at first actual partial or full entry fill, not at signal time.
strategies.loss_limit: Realized net P&L plus marked open exposure in tick-contract units; fees converted using pinned contract tick value. If unresolved, pause new entries. At or below-20, cancel entries and request exit; no new entries until next verified session.

inputs: Prior one-second adds at touch and within four ticks by side
Prior one-second passive fills by side
strategies.setup: One-tick spread, no open position; positive filled quantity on a qualifying side.

strategies.adverse: Small denominator can dominate; delayed entry, spread and fees may consume the association.

strategies.name: Price-response sequence recorder
strategies.trigger: Every eligible completed-group midpoint change of at least two ticks.
strategies.direction: Initial move is orientation, not a forecast.
inputs: Strictly subsequent additions, cancellations, fills and aggressive trades
strategies.record: Last eligible group at or before each horizon with its age; no interpolation. Also retain exact first half/full return and full available parent path, including no-response cases.
strategies.exit: Observation window end, reset or session end; not natural event death.
strategies.missing_data: Retain the event and explicit unavailable response.
strategies.conflicts: Separate same-group mechanics from later response and fixed-price queues from moving ranks.
strategies.dipole_role: Attach only then-known Native/flow states by their own clocks.
strategies.readiness: Verified NG recorder required; no order route needed.

strategies.name: Duration and flow-state context
strategies.trigger: Actual availability of the original frozen classifier after all 61 required samples and exact lineage are verified.
inputs: State, t0 and last complete sample clock
strategies.calibration: These are the original historical totals. Keep v4 separately until exact factors/bands are pinned. No new normalization or refitting.
strategies.exit: Observe target reach or right-censoring; do not equate deadline with reversal.
strategies.conflicts: Do not replace actual recognition with t0+50 or adjust state using book confidence.
strategies.adverse: Wide bands and day dependence; time to absolute distance does not select direction.
strategies.readiness: Causal classifier input contract and calibration files must be verified before automated use.

retained_other_hypotheses: All 11 stack arms, 10 continuous precursor predicates, original and inverse family screens, original SSOS and the historical 146-entry registry remain research hypotheses. No performance-based removal. Missing operational definitions remain explicit pending work.
